I'll assign items uniquely from the allowed list: Garchompite, Life Orb, Leftovers, Choice Scarf (for Dragapult? actually I'll give Dragapult Life Orb and Volcarona something else; let's distribute: Garchomp @ Garchompite, Volcarona @ Heavy-Duty? not available, use Fairy Feather? no, she's bug/fire, use Charcoal or Life Orb; Life Orb to Dragapult, Volcarona @ Charcoal? Actually Wise Glasses for special? Use Shell Bell? Let's do: Garchomp Garchompite, Volcarona @ Charcoal (boost fire), Toxapex @ Leftovers, Dragapult @ Life Orb, Incineroar @ Icy Rock? no, Incineroar @ Black Glasses (dark boost) or Lum Berry; Hatterene @ Twisted Spoon or Mental Herb. Use unique: Garchompite, Charcoal, Leftovers, Life Orb, Black Glasses, Twisted Spoon. EVs total max 66, max 32 per stat. Natures: Garchomp Jolly (Atk/Spe), Volcarona Timid (SpA/Spe), Toxapex Bold (Def), Dragapult Adamant or Jolly? Ghost/Dragon physical: Adamant with Life Orb, Incineroar Adamant (Atk), Hatterene Modest (SpA). Moves: Garchomp: Earthquake, Dragon Claw, Swords Dance, Protect (or Rock Slide). Mega Garchomp. Volcarona: Quiver Dance, Bug Buzz, Fiery Dance, Protect. Toxapex: Scald? not available, use Liquidation? actually Toxapex has Liquidation, Sludge Bomb, Recover, Toxic Spikes. Use Recover, Sludge Bomb, Liquidation, Haze. Dragapult: Dragon Dance, Dragon Darts, Phantom Force, U-turn (or Sucker Punch). Incineroar: Fake Out, Parting Shot, Darkest Lariat, Flare Blitz. Hatterene: Calm Mind, Dazzling Gleam, Psychic, Magic Bounce ability with Protect? Actually Magic Bounce, Stored Power? Use Stored Power, Calm Mind, Dazzling Gleam, Psychic. Good.

Adamant gives Atk up Spe down, so need Jolly for Spe. Use Jolly. Incineroar 32 Atk / 32 HP / 2 Def = 66 Adamant. Hatterene 32 SpA / 32 HP / 2 SpD = 66 Modest.

Items unique: Garchompite, Charcoal, Leftovers, Life Orb, Black Glasses, Twisted Spoon. All from list. Good.
